description:
Apporo platform brings your organization's ERP to your iPhone and iPad. It is built for Apporo customers in North America and Southeast Asia who run buildings, facilities and building-automation projects, so the people in the office and on site can reach the same business system their company already uses: messages, attendance, tasks and records, with their own permissions.

Apporo platform is a secure mobile client for an Odoo 18 Community server that your organization hosts. After you sign in, use the native Facility Desk for site work and service requests, alongside your organization's business system.

BEFORE YOU START
There is no sign-up screen and no trial account. Accounts are created by your organization's administrator. You need:
• The address and database name of your organization's server
• A username and password issued by your administrator
• A server reachable over HTTPS with a valid certificate (plain http is not accepted)
If you are not sure, ask your administrator first.

WHAT IT DOES
• Facility Desk. Tap the building icon, choose a site/project and view recent tasks with stage, due date when available, and high priority. Submit a service request with a title, description and priority; it is saved as a task in the selected project. Requires the Odoo Project module and access granted by your administrator.
• Simple two-step sign-in. The server field already shows https://. Enter the server and database, tap Next, then enter your username and password and tap Login. 
• Several sites side by side. Save connections to more than one server, for example head office and a project site, and switch between them. Each connection keeps its own sign-in and its own web data.
• Stays signed in. When a server session expires, the app signs in again in the background and returns you to where you were. Your password and session are kept in the iOS Keychain, on this device only.
• GPS on clock-in. When you clock in or out with your organization's attendance page, your current coordinates can be attached to that record. Location is read only when the page asks, only for the server you are signed in to, and never in the background. You can turn it off in Settings.
• App Lock. Protect the app with a 6-digit PIN and Face ID or Touch ID. The app locks when it goes to the background.
• Photos and files. When a form asks for an attachment, use the built-in iOS picker to take a photo, choose from your library or pick a file.
• Light, dark or system appearance, in English, Traditional Chinese or Simplified Chinese (follows your iOS language setting).

PERMISSIONS
• Location (While Using the App): only to attach coordinates to your attendance record when you clock in.
• Camera and Photos: only when you upload images to a form.
• Face ID: only to unlock the app.
• Notifications: to show messages from your organization's server when your organization has enabled notifications for Apporo platform. You can turn them off in iOS Settings.

PRIVACY
No ads or cross-app tracking. Firebase components may process installation identifiers and technical diagnostics for service operation, analytics and product improvement. Business data you submit is sent to your organization's Odoo server; the app also displays data your account is authorized to access. Details: https://www.apporo.ai/odoo-privacy-en

LIMITS
• Requires an Odoo 18 Community server run by your organization. Requires iOS 16 or later.
• No offline mode. Available screens depend on the modules and permissions your administrator has set up.
• No in-app purchases.

SUPPORT
• Help: https://www.apporo.ai/odoo-support-en
• Account deletion: https://www.apporo.ai/odoo-account-deletion-en (also in Settings > Delete Account)
• Email: info@apporo.ai
For account permissions and business data, contact your organization's administrator.

Apporo platform is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Odoo S.A. Odoo is a trademark of Odoo S.A.
